dog.description_text: Offsite Notice: Grits Grits is currently offsite at one of our trusted partners for a bit. They’re safe, comfortable, and getting lots of care while we help them find a loving match. If you're interested in bringing Grits home, start by completing an adoption survey and our team will contact you with next steps. Can't wait to add a new best friend to your family? We're thrilled to help you meet any of the cats at our temporary location at 232 Varet Street in Brooklyn or you can sign up to foster a cat or dog today!
